مِصْعَادٌ The [rope called] حَابُول, [made in the form of a hoop,] by means of which a man ascends palm-trees. (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- [And A scaling-ladder. ―
-b3- And, accord. to Freytag, A chain with which the feet of captives are shackled, to prevent their taking wide steps: ―
-b4- and A chain upon the feet of women, serving as an ornament: in relation to which he refers to Schröder de vestitu mulierum Hebr. p. 123.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
